newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek cash rates paralysed in late dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek cash rates paralysed in late dull trade.

text.p: Greek money rates and forex were hovering around morning levels in late lucklustre trade and dealers said all trading activity was in short periods with the central bank draining cash at 12.40 percent.
"It was a slow day with all deals in short periods up to a month," said a trader at a state bank. "Rates are holding and the central bank soaked overnight cash at 12.40 percent."
There was also little action in the central bank's fixing, dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 156.75/80 drachmas from Friday's 156.845 fix, the dollar at 239.70/75 drachmas from 240.040 and the Ecu at 300.35/45 from 300.040 drachmas.
